import csv
sid='cb0edc8a-8eba-5a9c-89e5-fb3668b1fc18'
d1='2018-07-24'
d2='2018-01-17'
v1=[];v2=[]
with open(VALUES_CSV) as f:
    r=csv.DictReader(f)
    for row in r:
        if row['timeseries_id']==sid:
            ts=row['timestamp']
            if ts.startswith(d1): v1.append(float(row['value']))
            if ts.startswith(d2): v2.append(float(row['value']))
print(len(v1),len(v2))
print(sum(v1)/len(v1), sum(v2)/len(v2))
print(sum(v2)/len(v2)-sum(v1)/len(v1))
